attributes.residual: MECHANISM FOUND AND CLOSED. real 869 -> 92, fuzzy 95.6052% -> 97.6835%, insns 575/576 -> 575/575 (EQUAL), frame 592/600 -> 592/592 (EQUAL), saved GPRs r24-r31 on both sides. THE ANSWER TO THE 284-BYTE QUESTION: the region is not an outgoing-parameter area. MWCC reserves each `static inline` FUNCTION expansion's own frame as a block at the bottom of the caller's frame, one per expansion site, then emits the expanded code against separately allocated temps higher up - so the blocks are never touched and their address is never formed. A block-scope MACRO doing identical work reserves nothing. Found by IMAGE CENSUS (2157 functions, dtk-split target objects): the shape is COMMON, 216 functions have an untouched low region >= 32 bytes, and the positive control was in the SAME TU - fn_80011DCC, already byte-exact, zero calls, 488-byte dead region, and it uses inline swap HELPERS where fn_8001267C used MACROS. Quantitative confirmation before any edit: dead bytes = 8-aligned sum of inlinee frames, Swap16 4 / Swap32 8 / SwapF32 16 (it nests Swap32). fn_80011DCC 1*4+12*8+24*16 = 484, measured 488. fn_8001267C 15*4+22*8+3*16 = 284, measured 284 EXACTLY. Converting the macros to the helper form gave 869 -> 215 on the FIRST probe and made the prior pass's u8 unused[248] pad surplus (deleted, free). Then a declared `AtreeDefinition* def` base killed the surplus addi r27,r24,54 PRE web and the 9th callee-saved GPR: 215 -> 96, counts and frame equal. Then reusing dead local seqoff as the node-info loop's offset accumulator moved the stride update to the target's position: 96 -> 92. REMAINING RESIDUAL, fully named, 92 real / 4 multiset tokens / 6 STRUCTURAL of which 4 are reloc-name only: (1) TWO zero-constant clusters, target `li rX,0` + `li rY,0` versus ours `li` + copy, at 0x1e4 (i/off in the match-list loop) and 0x384 (i/off in the per-match-entry loop), plus the consequent 4-byte branch-target skew at 0x160. SOURCE-REACHABLE - splitting the shared `off` carrier into a per-loop `moff` closes the 0x384 cluster outright - but NET-NEGATIVE, measured twice at two alignments with identical sign: real 96 -> 98 and 92 -> 94. Declaration order between the carriers is inert (two identical A/Bs). (2) THREE schedule/placement words: the node-info loop counter `addi rJ,rJ,1` still updates at the bottom where the target updates it at the top (the stride update moved, the counter did not); the outer `addi r27,r27,36` sits 4 bytes early; and `addi r3,r30,0` versus our `mr r3,r30` is a copy-form choice. (3) FOUR relocation rows that differ only in SYMBOL NAME - target `lbl_*` placeholders versus our real `natreelists` and a `...bss.0` section symbol - i.e. normalization artifacts of an unclaimed data region, not code. NEXT WORKER: do NOT re-spell the objectIndex address (six spellings inert) and do NOT re-probe the carrier split for net gain (twice measured -2). The live leads are the node-info loop-counter placement and the copy-form word.
